title: Senior Backend Developer (Distributed Systems)
description: Looking for an experienced Backend Developer to build scalable, high-throughput microservices, API gateways, and distributed data pipelines handling millions of daily requests.
responsibilities: Design, build, and optimize backend microservices using Python, Go, or Java.
Architect and maintain relational and NoSQL databases (PostgreSQL, Redis, MongoDB).
Implement asynchronous task queues and event-driven architectures with Kafka or RabbitMQ.
Containerize microservices with Docker and deploy to cloud environments.
requirements: 4+ years of backend engineering experience with Python, Go, or Node.js.
Deep expertise with PostgreSQL database indexing, transactions, and schema design.
Hands-on experience with caching layers (Redis) and message brokers (Kafka/RabbitMQ).
Experience building and securing REST and GraphQL APIs.
